description: This Java class defines a custom transition for Android animations that animates background color changes between scenes.

classes.name: ChangeColor
classes.description: A custom Transition class that animates background color changes between scenes.

methods.name: captureValues
methods.description: Captures the background drawable of a view for transition purposes.

methods.name: captureStartValues
methods.description: Captures the starting background drawable for the transition.

methods.name: captureEndValues
methods.description: Captures the ending background drawable for the transition.

methods.name: createAnimator
methods.description: Creates an animator that interpolates background color changes if the start and end backgrounds are ColorDrawables with different colors.
